column1: ELM Functional Requirement Specification — Coherent CFR ↔ Atomic AFR ↔ Specification Traceability

Formal arrangement: each CFR preserves one coherent business/system obligation; its AFRs provide independently verifiable engineering resolution. AFRs are not split mechanically by verbs. Integrity rule: SRS-EL-001…107 remains the immutable as-administered Phase-2 baseline. The historical ID and exact historical statement are retained beside each final AFR. Minimum Sufficient Representation is distinguished from broader traceability. Use Cases may be actor-triggered or event-triggered; the formal representation vocabulary remains only UC, BR, WF and their combinations.
